whenToUse: An editorial magazine, journal or essay publication with issues, topics, long reads and footnotes.
Writers who want a reading-progress bar, side notes and a filterable archive.
avoidWhen: A technical or engineering blog — use site-blog-02.
a11y: The reading progress bar is role="progressbar" and footnotes use role="note"; archive results are announced via aria-live.
Write real alt text for each article image.
